methods.name: CLI stats t-test-one, t-test-two, t-test-paired with missing values and Int64 columns
methods.reference: stats::t.test (one-sample with mu/conf.level, Welch, var.equal = TRUE, paired = TRUE; NA removed as t.test does)
methods.tolerance: text at print precision (Tol::printed: 4 decimals for statistics, means, CI bounds and counts tables, 6 for p-values and Shapiro W, 1-2 for df); -F json at validation/README.md by n: Tol::coef/se/stat/p_value(n) (n < 100: 1e-6 coefficients and means, 1e-5 statistics, SE, CI, p relative or 1e-12 absolute); Fisher conditional MLE and limits Tol::new(1e-9, 1e-12) against the uniroot(tol = 1e-15) re-solve; counts, df and missing-value summaries exact

methods.name: CLI stats wilcoxon (paired and rank-sum) with missing values
methods.reference: stats::wilcox.test (paired, exact); rank sum of x
quantities: rank-sum statistic as the rank sum R1 (R's W is R1 - n(n+1)/2, STAT-72)
rank-sum exact p not pinned (STAT-73, Tier 4)
methods.tolerance: text at print precision (Tol::printed: 4 decimals for statistics, means, CI bounds and counts tables, 6 for p-values and Shapiro W, 1-2 for df); -F json at validation/README.md by n: Tol::coef/se/stat/p_value(n) (n < 100: 1e-6 coefficients and means, 1e-5 statistics, SE, CI, p relative or 1e-12 absolute); Fisher conditional MLE and limits Tol::new(1e-9, 1e-12) against the uniroot(tol = 1e-15) re-solve; counts, df and missing-value summaries exact
